advanced-filter-description: Isihlungi Esithuthukisiwe sivumela ukubhala iyunithi yezinhlamvu equkethe ama-opharetha alandelayo: == != <= >= && || ( ) Isikhala sisetshenziswa njengesihlukanisi phakathi kwama-Opharetha. Ungakwazi ukuhlunga zonke izinkambu ngokwezifiso ngokuthayipha amagama azo kanye namanani. Isibonelo: Inkundla1 == Inani1. Qaphela: Uma izinkambu noma amanani equkethe izikhala, udinga ukuwahlanganisa zibe izingcaphuno ezizodwa. Isibonelo: 'Inkambu 1' == 'Inani 1'. Ukuze izinhlamvu zokulawula okukodwa (' \/) zeqiwe, ungasebenzisa \. Isibonelo: I-Field1 == I\'m. Futhi ungakwazi ukuhlanganisa izimo eziningi. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngokuvamile bonke opharetha bahunyushwa kusukela kwesokunxele kuya kwesokudla. Ungashintsha i-oda ngokubeka amabakaki. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Futhi ungasesha izinkambu zombhalo usebenzisa i-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-openproject: Namathisela i-JSON yeqoqo le-work-packages le-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Izimo ziba izinhlu futhi ama-work package aba amakhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namathisela i-array ye-JSON yezinkinga ze-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Izinkinga ziba amakhadi ahlanganiswe ngezinhlu ze-Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Namathisela i-JSON yokukhishwa kwemisebenzi ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } okuvela ekukhishweni kwe-Asana noma GET /tasks). Imisebenzi ihlanganiswa ngezigaba (izobulungu); imisebenzi ephelele iya ku-Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namathisela i-JSON yokukhishwa kohlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Izigaba ziba izinhlu futhi izinto ziba amakhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela uhlu lwemisebenzi lwe-markdown (indlela amathuluzi e-markdown-kanban afana ne-Obsidian Kanban asebenzisayo): izihloko ze- "## Igama loluhlu", nezinto ze- "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngaphansi. Izihloko ziba izinhlu futhi izinto zibe amakhadi; uhlu olulula lwamachashaza ngaphandle kwamabhokisi wokuhlola nalo liyangeniswa, njengamakhadi avulekile.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namathisela isakhiwo se-Leo (ifayela le-.leo). Izingxenye ezisezingeni eliphezulu ziba izinhlu, izingxenye ezingaphansi kwazo ngokuqondile ziba amakhadi, kuthi umbhalo wengxenye ube yincazelo yekhadi. Izingxenye ezisemazingeni ajulile ziba izinhlu zokuhlola. Izingxenye ezimakiwe zingeniswa njengeziqediwe.
import-board-instruction-opml: Namathisela uhlaka lwe-OPML, njengoba lukhishwa yi-Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq nezinye izinhlelo zohlaka. Izinto ezisezingeni eliphezulu ziba izinhlu, ezingaphansi kwazo ziba amakhadi anamanothi njengencazelo, kanti ezijulile ziba izinhlu zokuhlola. Izinto eziqediwe zingeniswa njengeziqediwe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Namathisela ifayela le-Org mode, njengoba libhalwa yi-Emacs, Orgzly noma Beorg. Izihloko ezisezingeni eliphezulu ziba izinhlu, kanti izihloko zezinga lesibili ziba amakhadi. TODO no-DONE, izinto eziza kuqala, amathegi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE no-CLOSED kuyagcinwa, kanti amabhokisi okumaka nezihloko ezijulile ziba izinhlu zokuhlola.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namathisela ifayela le-todo.txt: umsebenzi owodwa emgqeni ngamunye, ngendlela uhlelo lwe-todo.txt nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo eziyibhala ngayo. Imisebenzi eqediwe ("x") iya kokuthi Kuqediwe, +project no-@context kuba amalebula, (A) iba ilebula lokubaluleka, kanti due: no-t: kuba izinsuku zokugcina nezokuqala.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namathisela umphumela we-task export: uhlu lwe-JSON noma umsebenzi owodwa emgqeni ngamunye. Imisebenzi eqediwe iya ku-Done, i-project ne-priority kuba amalebula, i-annotations iba amazwana, kanti i-depends iba ukuncika emisebenzini evimbayo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khipha ifayela le-.boardarchive engobweni ecindezelwe bese unamathisela okuqukethwe kwe-board.jsonl yebhodi, nomugqa wenguqulo noma ngaphandle kwawo. Isici sokuqoqa ngamaqembu ekubukweni kwebhodi siba izinhlu, ezinye izici zokukhetha ziba amalebula, amabhulokhi ombhalo namabhokisi okuhlola aba incazelo nohlu lokuhlola, bese amazwana egcinwa. Izithombe nezinanyathiselwa azingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Ku-Todoist, vula imenyu yephrojekthi bese ukhetha Export as a template, bese unamathisela ifayela le-CSV. Izigaba ziba izinhlu, imisebenzi iba amakhadi, imisebenzi engaphansi iba uhlu lokuhlola, amanothi aba amazwana, kanti @labels nezinto eziza kuqala p1 kuya ku-p3 ziba amalebula.
import-board-instruction-planner: Ku-Microsoft Planner, vula imenyu yohlelo bese ukhetha Export plan to Excel, bese ukhetha lelo fayela le-.xlsx. Amaqoqo aba izinhlu nemisebenzi iba amakhadi, nabantu ababelwe yona, izinsuku, amalebula, uhlu lokuhlola nencazelo; Progress, Priority no-Completed By kuba izinkambu zangokwezifiso.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ku-MeisterTask, chofoza igama lephrojekthi, khetha Export project bese ukhipha i-CSV, bese uyinamathisela. Izigaba ziba izinhlu nemisebenzi iba amakhadi, namanothi, usuku lomnqamulajuqu, umuntu owabelwe yona namathegi; imisebenzi eqediwe igcina usuku lwayo lokuqedwa. I-CSV ebhalelwe ukungenisa kwe-MeisterTask nayo iyasebenza.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ku-Obsidian, vula ifayela lebhodi le-Kanban njenge-Markdown (noma uvule ifayela le-.md kumhleli wombhalo), bese unamathisela konke. Imizila iba izinhlu ezinemikhawulo yamakhadi yazo, amakhadi agcina amathegi, izinsuku, izinto eziza kuqala, izinkambu nohlu lokuhlola, kanti ingobo yomlando iba amakhadi afakwe kungobo yomlando.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ku-Linear, khipha izinkinga njenge-CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, noma ukukhishwa kokubuka), bese unamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba izinhlu, amaqembu aba imizila, nezinkinga ziba amakhadi nomuntu owabelwe zona, amalebula, izinsuku, inkinga engumzali, okubalulekile, isilinganiso, iphrojekthi nomjikelezo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ku-TickTick, vula Settings, Account, Backup & Import bese udala ikhophi eyisipele, bese unamathisela ifayela le-CSV. Uhlu ngalunye lwe-TickTick luba umzila namakholomu alo abe izinhlu; imisebenzi igcina amathegi, izinsuku, uhlu lokuhlola, izinto eziza kuqala nemisebenzi engaphansi.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ku-ClickUp, khipha imisebenzi njenge-CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, noma ukukhishwa kokubuka kwe-List noma Table okunawo wonke amakholomu), bese unamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba izinhlu, izinhlu ze-ClickUp ziba imizila, nemisebenzi iba amakhadi nemisebenzi engaphansi, abantu ababelwe yona, amathegi, izinsuku, izinto eziza kuqala nesikhathi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ku-Nullboard, vula ibhodi, khetha Export this board... kumenyu, vula ifayela le-.nbx kumhleli wombhalo bese unamathisela okuqukethwe kwalo. Izinhlu ziba izinhlu namanothi abe amakhadi: umugqa wokuqala wenothi uba isihloko sekhadi kanti okusele kube incazelo yalo. Inothi elingahluziwe lithola ilebula ethi raw. Ifayela elinamabhodi amaningi lingenisa ibhodi lalo lokuqala.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ku-Kanri, vula Import & Export bese ukhetha Export individual board (noma Export all data), bese unamathisela ifayela le-.json. Amakholomu aba izinhlu namakhadi abe amakhadi, nencazelo yawo, usuku lomnqamulajuqu, amathegi nemibala; imisebenzi yekhadi iba uhlu lokuhlola. Ekukhishweni kwayo yonke idatha kungeniswa ibhodi lokuqala.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ku-Pivotal Tracker, vula ithebhu ye-MORE yephrojekthi bese ukhetha Export CSV (noma ukhethe izindaba bese ukhetha Bulk Actions, CSV), bese unamathisela i-CSV. Isimo ngasinye sendaba siba uhlu nezindaba zibe amakhadi, nohlobo lwazo, amalebula, abanikazi, umceli, izinsuku, amazwana, imisebenzi nezithiyo; Estimate iba Story points kanti imijikelezo iba ama-sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ku-Tasks.org, vula Settings, Backups bese ukhetha Export tasks, bese unamathisela okuqukethwe kwalelo fayela le-.json. Izinhlu ziba izinhlu nemisebenzi ibe amakhadi, namanothi, amathegi, izinsuku, amazwana nemisebenzi engaphansi; imisebenzi eqediwe igcina usuku lwayo lokuqedwa, kanti okubalulekile kuba inkambu yangokwezifiso.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ku-monday.com, vula imenyu yebhodi, khetha More actions no-Export board to Excel (nezibuyekezo nezinto ezingaphansi uma uthanda), bese ukhetha lelo fayela le-.xlsx. Ikholomu ye-Status iba izinhlu namaqembu abe imizila; abantu, izinsuku, umugqa wesikhathi namathegi kugcina izindawo zazo, amanye amakholomu aba izinkambu zangokwezifiso nezibuyekezo zibe amazwana.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ku-Super Productivity, vula Settings, bese Sync & Backup, khetha Export Data bese unamathisela okuqukethwe kwefayela le-sp-backup .json. Iphrojekthi ngayinye iba umzila nemisebenzi ibe amakhadi ku-To Do, In Progress, Backlog noma Done, namanothi, amathegi, usuku lomnqamulajuqu, isikhathi esichithiwe nemisebenzi engaphansi; imisebenzi efakwe kungobo yomlando iba amakhadi afakwe kungobo yomlando.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ku-Taiga, vula Admin > Project > Export bese ulanda ikhophi yephrojekthi (qala ngokuvula iphakheji yefayela le-.json.gz), bese unamathisela i-JSON yalo. Izimo zezindaba zabasebenzisi ziba izinhlu, izindaba zabasebenzisi zibe amakhadi nemisebenzi yazo njengemisebenzi engaphansi, ama-epic nezinkinga zithola imizila yazo, kanti ama-sprint, amathegi, amazwana nezici zangokwezifiso kufakwa nakho. Okunamathiselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ku-Vikunja, vula Settings, khetha Data Export bese ulanda ifayela le-.zip elithunyelwa kuwe, bese ukhetha lelo fayela, noma unamathisele i-data.json engaphakathi kwalo. Amaqoqo e-Kanban aba izinhlu nemisebenzi ibe amakhadi, namalebula, abantu ababelwe yona, izinsuku, incazelo, izinhlu zemisebenzi njengezinhlu zokuhlola namazwana; okubalulekile, iphesenti lokuqedwa nesimo sokuqediwe kuba izinkambu zangokwezifiso. Okunamathiselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ku-Quire, vula imenyu yephrojekthi bese ukhetha Export CSV, bese unamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba izinhlu nemisebenzi ibe amakhadi, nemisebenzi engaphansi njengamakhadi angaphansi, abantu ababelwe yona, amathegi njengamalebula, izinsuku zokuqala, zomnqamulajuqu nezokuqedwa, incazelo nokubaluleka njengenkambu yangokwezifiso. Amazwana nokunamathiselwe akukho ku-CSV ye-Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ku-Wrike, khipha iphrojekthi noma ifolda ku-Excel, noma ugcwalise isifanekiso sokungenisa se-Excel se-Wrike, bese ukhetha lelo fayela le-.xlsx. Imigqa yamafolda namaphrojekthi iba imizila, Status iba izinhlu nemisebenzi ibe amakhadi, ne-Key, umsebenzi ongumzali, abantu ababelwe yona, izinsuku zokuqala nezokuphela, ukuncikana nencazelo; Priority, Duration namanye amakholomu kuba izinkambu zangokwezifiso.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ku-Teamwork.com, gcwalisa isifanekiso sokungenisa imisebenzi se-Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) bese usigcina njenge-.xlsx, bese ukhetha lelo fayela. Izinhlu zemisebenzi ziba izinhlu nemisebenzi ibe amakhadi; umsebenzi oqala ngophawu -, # noma > uba umsebenzi ongaphansi kwalowo ongaphezu kwawo (--, ## noma >> kube izinga elilodwa elijulile). Abantu ababelwe imisebenzi, izinsuku namathegi kugcina izindawo zazo; Priority, Estimated time no-Complete kuba izinkambu zangokwezifiso.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ku-Businessmap (eyayibizwa nge-Kanbanize), vula Advanced Search, khetha Configure results ukuze ukhethe amakholomu, landa ifayela le-Excel, bese ukhetha lelo fayela le-.xlsx. Amakholomu afundwa ngamagama awo esiNgisi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): uma i-akhawunti yakho isebenzisa olunye ulimi, qala ngokuqamba kabusha umugqa wezihloko ngesiNgisi. Column iba izinhlu kanti Lane iba imizila; abanikazi, amathegi, umbala, izinsuku, amazwana nezixhumanisi zabazali kugcina izindawo zazo, kanti Priority, Size, Type namanye amakholomu kuba izinkambu zangokwezifiso.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ku-Redmine, vula Issues yephrojekthi, khetha Also available in: CSV ngezansi kohlu, khetha amakholomu (All columns, ne-Description) bese ukhipha, bese unamathisela i-CSV. I-Redmine iqamba amakholomu ngolimi lwakho, ngakho setha ulimi lube English ku-My account ngaphambi kokukhipha. Isimo ngasinye siba uhlu nezinkinga zibe amakhadi, nesilandeleli njengelebula, umuntu owabelwe zona, umbhali, izinsuku, umsebenzi ongumzali nezinkinga ezihlobene; okubalulekile, isigaba, inguqulo ehlosiwe, isikhathi esilinganisiwe, % Done nezinkambu zangokwezifiso kuba izinkambu zangokwezifiso.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ku-Notion, vula isizindalwazi njengekhasi eligcwele, khetha ••• no-Export, khetha Markdown & CSV, bese ukhetha ifayela le-.zip elilandwayo, noma i-CSV eyodwa yesizindalwazi ngaphakathi kwalo, noma unamathisele leyo CSV. Ikholomu ebizwa nge-Status iba izinhlu (uma ingekho, kusetshenziswa ikholomu yokuqala ebukeka njengokukhetha, futhi umbiko wokungenisa usho ukuthi iyiphi); imigqa iba amakhadi nesihloko, amathegi njengamalebula, abantu njengamalungu, izinsuku nombhalo wekhasi njengencazelo; amanye amakholomu aba izinkambu zangokwezifiso. Ubudlelwano, izithombe nokunamathiselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ku-Plane, vula Workspace Settings, khetha Exports, khipha amaphrojekthi njenge-JSON, CSV noma Excel bese ulanda ifayela le-.zip, bese ukhetha lelo fayela, noma ifayela elilodwa ngaphakathi kwalo, noma unamathisele i-JSON noma i-CSV. Izimo ziba izinhlu, amaphrojekthi abe imizila, nezinkinga zibe amakhadi nesikhombi, umzali, abantu ababelwe zona, amalebula, izinsuku, izixhumanisi namazwana; okubalulekile, isilinganiso, umjikelezo nemojuli kuba izinkambu zangokwezifiso. Ukukhishwa kwe-Plane akunazo izincazelo noma okunamathiselwe, ngakho akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ebhodini lakho le-Trello, hamba ku-'Menu', bese uthi 'Okwengeziwe', 'Printa futhi Khipha', 'Khipha i-JSON', bese ukopisha umbhalo owumphumela.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namathisela Amanani Ahlukaniswe Ngokhefana(CSV)/ Ithebhu Amanani Ahlukaniswe (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-jira: Namathisela i-JSON evela ku-Jira Cloud REST API issue search (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), noma into elingana nayo { "issues": [...] }. Izimo ze-Jira ziba izinhlu futhi izinkinga ziba amakhadi. Ngokuzikhethela faka i-array "automationRules" ukungenisa imithetho.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetha isipredishithi se-.xlsx esifana ne-WeKan (amakholomu afanayo nokukhishwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, izinsuku, izinkambu zezifiso). Umugqa wokuqala uyisihloko.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ebhodini lakho, hamba 'kumenyu', bese 'Khipha ibhodi', bese ukopisha umbhalo efayeleni elilandiwe.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Uma uthola amaphutha lapho ungenisa ibhodi, ngezinye izikhathi ukungenisa kusasebenza, futhi ibhodi isekhasini Wonke Amabhodi.
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bagcine njengabasebenzisi ababambe indawo abanamagama abo, ukuze bafaniswe nabasebenzisi bangempela kamuva
csv-mapping-description: Khetha ikholomu yefayela enenkambu ngayinye yekhadi. Izinketho zenziwe ngokwamagama amakholomu; lungisa ezingalungile, bese ukhetha (ayikho efayeleni) ngenkambu engekho efayeleni.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Ifayela alinayo ikholomu yohlu. Khetha eyodwa ngenhla, noma uthayiphe igama lohlu olulodwa wonke amakhadi azofakwa kulo.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Amanye amakholomu azongeniswa njengezinkambu zombhalo zangokwezifiso:
csv-mapping-list-required: Thayipha igama lohlu wonke amakhadi azofakwa kulo, noma ukhethe ikholomu enohlu.
import-many-boards-hint: Khetha amafayela amaningi athunyelwe ngaphandle aleli thuluzi, noma i-.zip eyodwa enawo: ifayela ngalinye liba yibhodi lalo, lingeniswe ngaphandle kokufanisa amalungu. I-.zip yona uqobo engukuthunyelwa ngaphandle okukodwa (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, noma WeKan enezinamathiselo) iba yibhodi elilodwa. Uma amafayela ekhethwe lapha, inkinobho yokungenisa ingenisa wona esikhundleni senkambu engenhla.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Umzila ngamunye obuzokwakhiwa ukungenisa (iphrojekthi, ifolda noma uhlu lwethuluzi) uba yibhodi lawo. Amakhadi angabazali nokuncika phakathi kwalawo mabhodi kubhalwa embikweni wokungenisa.
export-all-boards-hint: Wonke amabhodi ongawathumela ngaphandle, ekulandweni okukodwa: i-Excel njengencwadi eyodwa eneshidi lebhodi ngalinye eliqanjwe ngegama lalo, zonke ezinye izinhlobo njenge-.zip enefayela lebhodi ngalinye.
import-json-placeholder: Namathisela idatha yakho evumelekile ye-JSON lapha
import-csv-placeholder: Namathisela idatha yakho evumelekile ye-CSV/TSV lapha
import-attachments-zip: I-ZIP yokunamathiselwe kwe-Trello (ngokuzikhethela, kusuka ku-Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Ibhodi elilodwa le-Trello elikhishwe njenge-.json. Uma ugcine i-Trello API key ne-token, okunamathiselwe kwayo, isisekelo sebhodi kanye nezithombe zamalungu nakho kuyalandwa.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: I-.zip enefayela elilodwa noma amaningi ebhodi e-.json kanye nokunamathiselwe kwawo kuma-subfolder anegama-lebhodi (kusuka ku-Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Wonke amabhodi ayangeniswa.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: Awakho amafayela ebhodi le-Trello .json atholakele ku-.zip.
import-trello-zip-progress: Kungeniswa amabhodi kusuka ku-.zip, sicela ulinde…
import-timeout: Ukungenisa kuthathe isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi kumisiwe. Sicela uzame futhi; uma kuqhubeka kwenzeka, ibhodi lingase libe likhulu kakhulu noma isizindalwazi simatasa.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: I-.zip inamafayela amaningi kakhulu ukuze angeniswe.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Ifayela elingaphakathi kwe-.zip likhulu kakhulu ukuze lingeniswe.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: I-.zip iqukethe izindlela zamafayela ezingaphephile futhi yenqatshelwe.
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Ibhodi elingenisiwe libekwa ngaphansi kwale ndawo yokusebenza, elidalwa uma lingekho
import-trello-parent-workspace: Beka izindawo zokusebenza ezingenisiwe ngaphansi kwa
trello-api-import: Ngenisa ngokuqondile kusuka ku-Trello nge-API key ne-token
trello-api-import-desc: Namathisela i-Trello API key ne-token yakho ukuze uhlele izindawo zakho zokusebenza ze-Trello namabhodi, bese ungenisa lawo akhethiwe nokunamathiselwe kwawo.
trello-api-token: I-Trello API token (edalwe ngesandla ngaphansi kwe-API key)
trello-api-credentials-required: Sicela ufake kokubili i-Trello API key ne-token.
trello-api-credentials-saved: I-Trello API key ne-token kulondoloziwe. Ungahlela izindawo zokusebenza ngaphandle kokuphinde uzifake.
trello-select-boards: Sicela ukhethe okungenani ibhodi elilodwa ukuze ulingenise.
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: Khansela ukungenisa bese ususa amabhodi asengeniswe yilo msebenzi? Lokhu akunakuguqulwa.
import-members-map: Ibhodi lakho elingenisiwe linamalungu athile. Sicela ubeke imephu amalungu ofuna ukuwangenisa kubasebenzisi bakho
import-members-map-note: Qaphela: Amalungu angamethiwe azokwabelwa umsebenzisi wamanje.
import-user-select: Khetha umsebenzisi wakho okhona ofuna ukumsebenzisa njengaleli lungu
invalid-year: Unyaka ongavumelekile. Thayipha zonke izinombolo ezine, isibonelo 2026.
label-delete-pop: Akukho ukuhlehlisa. Lokhu kuzosusa le lebula kuwo wonke amakhadi futhi kucekele phansi umlando wayo.
last-admin-desc: Awukwazi ukushintsha izindima ngoba kufanele okungenani kube nomlawuli oyedwa.
leave-board-pop: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukushiya __boardTitle__? Uzokhishwa kuwo wonke amakhadi kuleli bhodi.
list-archive-cards: Hambisa wonke amakhadi akulolu hlu kungobo yomlando
list-archive-cards-pop: Lokhu kuzosusa wonke amakhadi akulolu hlu ebhodini. Ukuze ubuke amakhadi Kungobo yomlando futhi uwabuyisele ebhodini, chofoza okuthi “Imenyu"> “Faka kungobo yomlando”.

list-delete-suggest-archive: Ungahambisa uhlu Kungobo yomlando ukuze uyisuse ebhodini futhi ulondoloze umsebenzi.

normal-assigned-only-desc: Amakhadi abelwe kuphela abonakalayo. Hlela njengomsebenzisi Ojwayelekile.
notify-participate: Thola izibuyekezo kunoma imaphi amakhadi owabamba iqhaza njengomdali noma ilungu
notify-watch: Thola izibuyekezo kunoma imaphi amabhodi, izinhlu, noma amakhadi owabukayo
page-maybe-private: Leli khasi lingase libe yimfihlo. Ungakwazi ukukubuka ngokuthi logging in.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Usesho lungabandakanya ama-opharetha ukuze acwenge ukusesha.  Ama-opharetha acaciswa ngokubhala igama lomsebenzisi nenani elihlukaniswe koloni.  Isibonelo, ukucaciswa komsebenzisi kokuthi `list:Blocked` kungakhawulela ukusesha kumakhadi aqukethwe ohlwini oluqanjwe ngokuthi *Ovinjiwe*.  Uma inani liqukethe izikhala noma izinhlamvu ezikhethekile kufanele lifakwe kuzimpawu zokucaphuna (isb. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - ​​amakhadi okumele akhokhe kufike ezinsukwini *<n>* kusukela manje.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ubala wonke amakhadi adlule usuku lwawo lomnqamulajuqu.
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - ​​wonke amakhadi afakwe kungobo yomlando nangafakwanga kungobo yomlando
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - ​​lapho *<field>* ingenye ye-`__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noma `__predicate_member__`.  Ukubeka okuthi `-` ngaphambi kokuthi *<field>* kusesha ukungabikho kwevelu kuleyo nkambu (isb. `has:-due` usesha amakhadi ngaphandle kwedethi yamanqamu).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - ​​lapho *<sort-name>* ingenye ye-`__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noma `__predicate_modified__`.  Ukuze uthole uhlobo olwehlayo, beka `-` ngaphambi kwegama lokuhlunga.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - ​​lapho *<n>* iyinani eliphelele elibonisa inombolo yamakhadi azoboniswa ekhasini ngalinye.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ama-opharetha afanayo *NOMA* ahlanganiswe ndawonye.  Amakhadi afana nanoma yimiphi imibandela azobuyiswa.
U-`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` uzobuyisela amakhadi aqukethwe kunoma yiluphi uhlu oluqanjwe ngokuthi *Ovinjiwe* noma *Okutholakalayo*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ama-opharetha ahlukene *FUTHI* ahlanganiswe ndawonye.  Amakhadi afana nawo wonke ama-opharetha ahlukene abuyiselwayo.  U-`__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` ubuyisela amakhadi kuphela ohlwini *Okutholakalayo* anelebula *elibomvu*.

Ukusebenzisa i-Compact kubuyisa isikhala esikhululiwe ngokuphinda kubhalwe idatha yeqoqo. Yenza lokhu kuphela ngemva kokuba ukuhamba kwamafayela ngobuningi kuphelile.

azure-connection-string-description: Ngokuzikhethela: sebenzisa i-string yoxhumano ephelele esikhundleni segama le-akhawunti nokhiye.
database-migration-description: Fudukisa idatha esekelwe kumbhalo (yonke into ngaphandle kokunamathiselwe nama-avatar, ahlala kwi-filesystem) phakathi kwe-MongoDB ne-FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Enye i-database kumele isebenze futhi ifinyeleleke (iziqhingi ezizenzakalelayo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; guqula nge-WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ngemva kokuba kuqedile, khomba i-MONGO_URL kwenye i-database bese uqala kabusha i-WeKan (ku-Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb noma =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Fudukisa idatha yombhalo iye ku-FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Kopisha wonke amaqoqo asekelwe kumbhalo aye ku-__db__? Okunamathiselwe nama-avatar akwi-filesystem akuthinteki. I-database okuyiwa kuyo kumele isebenze.
sandstorm-migration-description: Uma i-WeKan isebenza ngaphakathi kwe-Sandstorm grain, i-database yayo endala ye-MongoDB 3 ifudukiselwa ku-FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ekuqaleni kokuqala, futhi okunamathiselwe nama-avatar kuhanjiswa kusuka ku-database kuye kuma-directory e-files/attachments ne-files/avatars e-grain. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi lokho kufuduka kuphumelele yini nokuthi ingakanani indawo yediski amafayela e-database ye-MongoDB endala amabisawasebenzisa ngaphakathi kwe-grain, futhi kukuvumela ukususa lawo mafayela angahluziwe ukukhulula isikhala.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ngemva kokufuduka okuphumelelayo idatha ihlala ku-FerretDB nakwi-filesystem, ngakho amafayela endala e-database ye-MongoDB 3 angahluziwe angasuswa ukukhulula isikhala sediski se-grain. Lokhu akunakuguqulwa.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Susa amafayela e-database ye-MongoDB 3 angahluziwe ukukhulula isikhala sediski? Idatha isivele ifudukiselwe ku-FerretDB nakwi-filesystem. Lokhu akunakuguqulwa.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Amafayela e-database ye-MongoDB angahluziwe asusiwe, kukhululwe
features-desc: Izici ongazikhetha ezinikezwa yile WeKan. Isici esingamakiwe sifihlwa esibonakalayo sawo wonke umuntu. Idatha yaso iyagcinwa futhi izimvume azishintshi.
feature-views-overview-desc: Izibalo, ukuqoqwa ngokomuntu owabelwe, uhlelo lomgwaqo, ideshibhodi nebhodi elikhulu.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Uhlu lomsebenzi womkhiqizo, izikhathi ezimfushane zomsebenzi, umbiko wesikhathi somsebenzi nesivinini.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Umsebenzi osele nophelile, ukugeleza okuqoqekile, isikhathi somjikelezo nesokuletha, inani lomsebenzi ophelile, ubudala bomsebenzi, izithiyo, i-Monte Carlo nezinye izilinganiso zokugeleza.
feature-approval-required: Gcina izici ezifakwe yizibuyekezo ze-WeKan zivaliwe kuze kube umlawuli uyazivula
feature-preview-admins: Abalawuli babona izici ezivaliwe ukuze bazizame kuqala
card-field-visibility-desc: Izinkambu zezilungiselelo zebhodi / ikhadi ezingaboniswa amabhodi. Inkambu engamakiwe ifihliwe kuwo wonke amakhadi, amakhadi amancane nasezilungiselelweni zebhodi / ikhadi zawo wonke amabhodi. Ayikho idatha yekhadi noma isilungiselelo sebhodi esishintshayo, futhi ukuyimaka futhi kubonisa ibhodi ngalinye njengoba lalimisiwe. Ukuhleleka kwezinkambu kungokwebhodi ngalinye.
cards-loading-description: Indlela ibhodi ngalinye elilayisha ngayo amakhadi alo. Wonke amakhadi: ikhadi ngalinye liyalayishwa kwisiphequluli (okulula kunazo zonke, zonke izici ziyasebenza, kodwa ibhodi elinamakhadi ayizinkulungwane lithumela idatha eningi kumbukeli ngamunye). Ivila: uhlu ngalunye lulayisha kuphela amakhadi abonakalayo manje (ukuskrola okungenamkhawulo) kanye nenani eliphilayo, ngakho amabhodi amakhulu kakhulu asebenzisa inkumbulo ne-bandwidth encane. Kusethwa nayi-CARDS_LOADING environment variable.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ukulayisha kwekhadi ngevila kusengokuvivinya: izibali zekhadi nemikhawulo ye-WIP inembile, kodwa imibukiso ye-Calendar/Table/Gantt nokukhetha okuningi kukhombisa amakhadi alayishwe kuze kube manje kuphela. Layisha kabusha amabhodi avuliwe ngemva kokushintsha lokhu.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, wonke amalinki (kokubili amalinki e-markdown afana ne-[label](url) namathegi we-HTML ahlukile <a href>) ngaso sonke isikhathi abonakala njengombhalo omsulwa ongachofozeki kuzo zonke izinkambu zombhalo ocebile (izihloko zebhodi nekhadi, izincazelo, amazwana, izinhlu zokuhlola, njll.). Lokhu kuvimbela amalinki achofozekayo akhohlisayo. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe, ngakho amalinki ahlala echofozeka.
always-show-code-as-text: Ngaso sonke isikhathi bonisa wonke ikhodi njengombhalo omsulwa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, umbhalo ocebile awulokothi ubonakaliswe njenge-markdown noma i-HTML: umthombo wonke ngaso sonke isikhathi ubonakaliswa njengombhalo omsulwa kuzo zonke izinkambu zombhalo ocebile (izihloko zebhodi nekhadi, izincazelo, amazwana, izinhlu zokuhlola, njll.). Lokhu kuveza okuqukethwe okufihliwe — amazwana e-HTML (<!-- -->), umgomo wamalinki e-markdown, i-JavaScript nanoma iyiphi enye ikhodi — ngakho yonke ikhodi ihlala ibonakala, ingachofozeki, futhi ingasebenzi. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe, ngakho i-markdown ibonakaliswa ngokuvamile.
disable-all-import-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, zonke izici zokungenisa zicishiwe: ukungenisa ibhodi kusuka ku-WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne-Forgejo, kanye nokuklona ibhodi. Izinketho zemenyu yokungenisa zifihliwe futhi iseva yenqaba noma isiphi isicelo sokungenisa. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
disable-all-export-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, zonke izici zokukhipha zicishiwe: ukukhipha ibhodi njenge-WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, noma ku-NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, nokukhipha okunamathiselwe okukodwa. Izinketho zemenyu yokukhipha zifihliwe futhi iseva yenqaba noma isiphi isicelo sokukhipha. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, ama-avatar (izithombe zephrofayela zomsebenzisi) awalokothi angeniswe. Lokhu kufaka ukungenisa i-WeKan JSON, ukungenisa i-Trello, nokuvumelanisa i-avatar kubahlinzeki bomazisi bangaphandle lapho ungena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Amagama nenye idatha kusengeniswa; kuphela ama-avatar aweqiwa. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
disable-export-avatars-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, ama-avatar (izithombe zephrofayela zomsebenzisi) awalokothi afakwe lapho kukhishwa ibhodi (WeKan JSON ne-CSV export). Amagama abasebenzisi nenye idatha kusengakhishwa; kuphela ama-avatar ashiywa ngaphandle. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, ukungenisa ibhodi le-WeKan JSON kuthatha indawo yegama lomsebenzisi ngamunye ongenisiwe, igama eliphelele nezinhlamvu zokuqala ngezibambi zezibalo (user1, user2, ...), kususe i-avatar yakhe, futhi ubhale kabusha @username okushiwo (kanye nezinkambu ze-requested-by / assigned-by) ngaphakathi kokuqukethwe kwekhadi nezwana elingenisiwe. Akukho ubunikazi bomsebenzisi bangempela obuvela ebhodini lomthombo obugcinwayo. Igama elithi "user" lilandela ulimi lomuntu ongenisayo. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
anonymize-export-users-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, ukukhipha ibhodi kuthatha indawo yegama lomsebenzisi ngamunye okhishiwe, igama eliphelele nezinhlamvu zokuqala ngezibambi zezibalo (user1, user2, ...), kususe i-avatar yakhe, futhi ubhale kabusha @username okushiwo (kanye nezinkambu ze-requested-by / assigned-by) ngaphakathi kokuqukethwe kwekhadi nezwana. Ifayela elikhishiwe alinabunikazi bomsebenzisi bangempela. Igama elithi "user" lilandela ulimi lomuntu okhiphayo. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Uma kunikwe amandla, ukukhipha ibhodi kuthatha indawo yegama lomsebenzisi ngamunye okhishiwe, igama eliphelele nezinhlamvu zokuqala ngezibambi zezibalo (user1, user2, ...), kususe i-avatar yakhe, futhi ubhale kabusha @username okushiwo (kanye nezinkambu ze-requested-by / assigned-by) ngaphakathi kokuqukethwe kwekhadi nezwana. Ifayela elikhishiwe alinabunikazi bomsebenzisi bangempela. Igama elithi "user" lilandela ulimi lomuntu okhiphayo. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
disable-activities-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, amarekhodi omfudlana wemisebenzi awalokothi arekhodwe futhi awalokothi aboniswe ndawana (ibha eseceleni yebhodi nethebhu yomsebenzi wekhadi). Akukho mlando wokuthi ngubani owenzeni ogcinwayo. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
disable-notifications-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, i-WeKan ayilokothi ithumele izaziso zokubuka (ku-app, i-imeyili noma ezinye izinsizakalo) kunoma iyiphi imisebenzi. Imisebenzi isengarekhodwa (ngaphandle uma kukhutshazwe nangenhla); kuphela izaziso ezicindezelwayo. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
disable-watch-description: Uma kunikwe amandla, isici sokubuka sicishiwe — abasebenzisi abakwazi ukubhalisela amabhodi, izinhlu noma amakhadi ukuthola izaziso, futhi noma yimuphi umzamo wokushintsha izinga lokubuka uyenqatshelwa. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe.
backup-description: Gcina i-backup Yokunamathiselwe, Ama-avatar kanye/noma Idatha (wonke amaqoqo asekelwe kumbhalo angewona okunamathiselwe noma ama-avatar). I-.zip isakazwa ngokuqondile kwisitoreji esikhethiwe — akukho fayela lesikhashana — njenge-backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, equkethe YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ne-/data. Izitoreji zeklaudi (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zisebenzisa imininingwane yokugunyaza elungiswe kumathebhu azo esitoreji.
backup-scope-description: Yonke iseva, noma inhlangano eyodwa. Isipele senhlangano siqukethe amabhodi ayo nakho konke okukuwo, kufaka phakathi izinamathiselo zalawo mabhodi — kodwa awukho ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi nezilungiselelo zeseva, ngoba lokho kwabelwana ngakho zonke izinhlangano. Ukubuyisela isipele senhlangano kubhala kuphela emabhodini angawaleyo nhlangano.
continuous-backup-description: Kuthumela lonke ushintsho kusizindalwazi, kokunamathiselwe, kuma-avatar nasemibhalweni yomlando kufolda ngemizuzwana embalwa, ukuze kubuyiselwe isimo sanoma yisiphi isikhathi. Kusebenza kanye nesipele esihleliwe, esakha izingobo zomlando eziphelele.
continuous-backup-target: Ifolda okuya kuyo (indlela ephelele kwenye idiski, endaweni eyabiwe yenethiwekhi noma endaweni exhunywe nge-rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Ayikho injini yesizindalwazi engasebenza kule seva
continuous-backup-key-file: Ifayela lokhiye wokubethela (indlela ephelele ngaphandle kwefolda okuya kuyo; izinhlamvu ezingama-64 zohlelo lwezinombolo olusekelwe ku-16 noma umushwana oyimfihlo onezinhlamvu okungenani eziyi-16). Gcina ikhophi: ngaphandle kwalo ifayela isipele asikwazi ukubuyiselwa.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Ifayela lesizindalwazi se-SQLite (lakhiwa eceleni kwesipele, alilokothi libhale phezu kwefayela elisetshenziswayo)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Sebenzisa isizindalwazi se-SQLite esakhiwe kabusha ekuqaliseni kabusha okulandelayo (isizindalwazi esidala esithathelwe indawo sizogcinwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela isizukulwane esikhethiwe esimweni sesikhathi esikhethiwe? Isipele esiqhubekayo sizoma okwesikhashana ngesikhathi sokubuyisela.
backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela i-backup ekhethiwe? Okunamathiselwe/ama-avatar kubhalwa kwi-filesystem futhi idatha ku-database ngokwemodi ekhethiwe.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ngokuzikhethela: indlela eya kufayela lokhiye we-akhawunti yesevisi le-JSON kwiseva.
gcs-credentials-description: Ngokuzikhethela: namathisela ukhiye we-akhawunti yesevisi le-JSON. Shiya kungenalutho ukusebenzisa ifayela lokhiye noma imininingwane ezenzakalelayo.
gcs-permissions-note: Nika i-akhawunti yesevisi ye-WeKan ukufinyelela kokufunda/kokubhala kwi-bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → i-bucket yakho → Permissions → Grant access. Ku-"New principals", namathisela i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yesevisi — inani le-"client_email" kusuka kukhiye wakho we-JSON — bese ukhetha indima "Storage Object Admin" bese uLondoloza.
gcs-bucket-description: Igama le-bucket ye-Cloud Storage lokugcina amafayela.

azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Data storage → Containers → isiqukathi sakho (noma + Container ukudala esisodwa).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → isikhetha-projekthi phezulu → i-ID yeprojekthi yakho (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → igama le-bucket yakho (noma Create ukwenza esisodwa).

gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → i-akhawunti yakho yesevisi → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (kulanda ifayela). Namathisela okuqukethwe kwalo lapha, noma londoloza ifayela bese usetha indlela yalo ngenhla.

comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Yenza ukuhlola okuphelele nokulungiswa kobuqotho bedatha yebhodi, okuhlanganisa ukuhleleka kohlu, ukuma kwamakhadi, nesakhiwo sokubhukuda.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Isusa ngokuphephile izinhlu eziyimpinda ezingenalutho. Isusa kuphela izinhlu ezingenawo amakhadi FUTHI ibe nolunye uhlu olunesihloko esifanayo esiqukethe amakhadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Ithola futhi ibuyisele amakhadi nezinhlu ezine-swimlaneId engekho noma i-listId. Idala indlela yokubhukuda 'Yamakhadi Alahlekile' ukuze wenze zonke izinto ezilahlekile zibonakale futhi.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Ibuyisela zonke izindawo zokubhukuda ezifakwe kungobo yomlando, izinhlu, namakhadi. Ilungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo noma iyiphi i-swimlaneId engekho noma i-listId ukuze wenze izinto zibonakale.

fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Ibuyekeza ama-URL e-avatar ukuze amalungu ebhodi asebenzise i-backend yesitoreji efanele futhi alungise izithenjwa eziphukile ze-avatar.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Ibuyekeza wonke ama-URL ananyathiselwe ifayela kuleli bhodi ukuze asebenzise isipele esilungile sesitoreji futhi alungise izithenjwa zefayela eziphukile.
migrations-admin-only: Abaphathi bebhodi kuphela abangasebenzisa ukuthuthela kwelinye izwe
migrations-description: Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuqotho bedatha nokulungiswa kwaleli bhodi. Ukuthutha ngakunye kungenziwa ngakunye.

run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Lokhu kuzoqale kuguqule noma iluphi uhlu olwabiwe lube uhlu lokubhukuda ngakunye, bese kusula uhlu olungenalutho olunohlu oluyimpinda olunesihloko esifanayo esiqukethe amakhadi. Uhlu olungenalutho olungadingeki ngempela kuphela oluzosuswa. Qhubeka?

run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzothola futhi kulungise izinhlu ezingekho noma ezonakele esakhiweni sebhodi. Qhubeka?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzobuyekeza ama-URL e-avatar ukuze amalungu ebhodi asebenzise i-backend yesitoreji efanele. Qhubeka?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Lokhu kuzobuyekeza wonke ama-URL okunamathiselwe kwifayela kuleli bhodi ukuze kusetshenziswe isipele esilungile sesitoreji. Qhubeka?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Awekho ama-swimlanes alahlekile, izinhlu, noma amakhadi azobuyiselwa
migration-progress-note: Sicela ulinde ngenkathi sithuthela ibhodi lakho esakhiweni sakamuva...
conversion-info-text: Lokhu kuguqulwa kwenziwa kanye ebhodini ngalinye futhi kuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ungaqhubeka nokusebenzisa ibhodi ngokujwayelekile.
converting-board-description: Ukuguqula isakhiwo sebhodi ukuze kusebenze okuthuthukisiwe. Lokhu kungase kuthathe isikhashana.

import-board-source: Ngenisa ibhodi (Trello, Jira, ifayela le-WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)

blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa inani lezinhlamvu (kufaka nezikhala) embhalweni onikeziwe.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Phrinta umbhalo, inombolo noma elinye inani elicacisiwe.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Shintsha konke ukuvela kombhalo othile ngaphakathi komunye umbhalo.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: susa izikhala kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zika
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa ikhophi yombhalo enezikhala ezisusiwe komunye umkhawulo noma kuyo yomibili.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Okuguquguqukayo okubizwa ngokuthi '%1' sekuvele kukhona kolunye uhlobo: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Okuguquguqukayo okubizwa ngokuthi '%1' sekuvele kukhona njengepharamitha emsebenzini '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Sesha indawo yokusebenza. Cindezela u-Enter ukuthola okufanayo okulandelayo, u-Shift+Enter ukuthola okufanayo okwangaphambili. Cindezela u-Escape ukuvala ukusesha nokugxila kokufanayo kwamanje.
r-blocks-help: Xhuma isiqalisi esisodwa esenzweni esisodwa. Hudula amabhulokhi ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Sebenzisa umhleli wefomu ukuze uthole izinketho ezithuthukile.
r-blocks-unavailable: Idatha yomthetho ayitholakali. Sebenzisa umhleli wefomu ukuze ubuyekeze lo mthetho.
r-blocks-invalid: Xhuma isiqalisi esisodwa kuphela esenzweni esisodwa. Susa amabhulokhi angaxhunyiwe noma engeziwe ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
r-blocks-conflict: Lo mthetho ushintshile ngenkathi uhlela. Layisha kabusha umthetho olondoloziwe ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
r-blocks-permission: Kudingeka imvume yomphathi webhodi ukuze uhlele imithetho.
scrum-releases-select-help: Ikhadi lingaba sekukhishweni okuningi. Bamba u-Ctrl (u-Cmd ku-Mac) ukuze ukhethe okungaphezu kokukodwa; sula konke okukhethiwe ukuze ususe ikhadi kukho konke ukukhishwa.
scrum-select-sprint: Khetha i-sprint ukuze ubone umbiko wayo.
scrum-backlog-help: Hlela umsebenzi ngokwezinga lomsebenzi osalindile. Yabela amakhadi i-sprint ehleliwe noma esebenzayo.
scrum-report-help: Imibiko igcina izilinganiso ezivela ezifinyezweni ezigciniwe zama-sprint. Izilinganiso ezingaziwa zibalwa ngokwehlukana; akuzona izilinganiso zikaziro. Qhathanisa isivinini somsebenzi kuphela uma amayunithi ezilinganiso nezinqubomgomo kufana.
scrum-confirm-close: Vala le sprint futhi ulondoloze imiphumela yayo? Amakhadi angakaqedwa azothuthelwa endaweni ekhethiwe.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Khansela le sprint? Amakhadi ayo ahlala eyingxenye yayo aze abelwe kwenye indawo.
scrum-partial-report: Umbiko ongaphelele: kufakwe kuphela amakhadi owabelwe wona njengamanje.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Le sprint iqukethe kuphela ingxenye yesifinyezo sokuqala.
scrum-rollover-progress: Kuhanjiswa amakhadi e-sprint aya phambili: __done__ kwangu-__total__
scrum-history-job-running: Kuhlehliswa noma kwenziwa kabusha ushintsho olukhulu: __done__ emigqeni yomlando engu-__total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Ukuhlehlisa noma ukwenza kabusha ushintsho olukhulu kumile. Cindezela hlehlisa noma yenza kabusha futhi ukuze uqhubeke:
scrum-daily-observations-help: Ibha ngayinye ibonisa okubonwe kuqala kwase kuqoshwa ngosuku lwe-UTC, ngesikhathi esibonisiwe. Izinsuku ezingekho azifakwa. Lokhu okubonwayo akuqophi lonke ushintsho futhi akubonisi amanani okuphela kosuku. Izilinganiso ezingaziwa azizona uziro. Sebenzisa isenzo sokukhipha salesi sigaba ukuze ukhiphe okubonwa nsuku zonke; isenzo sokukhipha esikubha yamathuluzi sikhipha imiphumela ye-sprint.
scrum-daily-empty: Akukho okubonwa nsuku zonke okuqoshiwe kule sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Ububanzi bomsebenzi nomsebenzi osele, ushintsho ngalunye
scrum-scope-history-help: Kwakhiwe kabusha ngomlando webhodi kusukela ekuqaleni kwesikhathi somsebenzi: umugqa owodwa woshintsho ngalunye kumakhadi esikhathi somsebenzi, ezilinganisweni noma emsebenzini oqediwe.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Umlando awukhiqizi kabusha isithombe sesimo salesi sikhathi somsebenzi uqobo: ezinye izinguquko zenziwa ngaphandle kokubhalwa emlandweni, ngakho la manani awaphelele.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Kufundeke izinguquko zokuqala kuphela; ukwakha kabusha akuphelele.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Azikho izinguquko kusukela ekuqaleni kwesikhathi somsebenzi.
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Ikhadi ligcinwe kungobo yomlando noma libuyiselwe
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Okubonwe kuqala kwase kuqoshwa ngosuku ngalunye lwe-UTC; izinsuku ezingekho azifakwa. Okubonwayo akuqophi lonke ushintsho noma amanani okuphela kosuku. Izilinganiso ezingaziwa azizona uziro.
scrum-import-pending: Ukungeniswa kwe-Scrum akuphelele. Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum nokukhipha imibiko akutholakali.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Ukungenisa okuphazanyiswe ukuqala kabusha kungaqedelwa lapha ngemva kokuma. Uma uhlelo lokungenisa lungazange lugcinwe luphelele, kungakhanselwa kuphela; lokhu akushintshi lutho ebhodini.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Khetha ifayela lokukhishwa kwebhodi le-WeKan noma lokudlulisa i-Scrum. Ama-sprint nokukhishwa okuvele kukhona kuleli bhodi kuyaxhunywa, akuphindwa. Amakhadi afaniswa nge-ID, noma ngenombolo yekhadi nesihloko; amakhadi angafani afakwa ohlwini futhi ashiywa engashintshiwe. Buka kuqala ukuze ubone okuzoshintsha.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ama-sprint: __created__ amasha, __matched__ asevele ekuleli bhodi, __skipped__ awangeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-releases: Ukukhishwa: __created__ okusha, __matched__ okuvele kukuleli bhodi, __skipped__ okungangeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Akukho okuzoshintshwa: leli bhodi selinakho lokhu kuhlelwa.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum kungenisiwe futhi kwaqoshwa emlandweni.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikhadi lifana namakhadi angaphezu kwelilodwa kuleli bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikhadi lingelelinye ibhodi futhi lishiywe lingashintshiwe: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: I-sprint noma ukukhishwa kufana nokungaphezu kokukodwa kuleli bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: I-sprint, ukukhishwa noma umcimbi akukwazanga ukungeniswa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Khetha inani lokungqubuzana ngakunye. Ukuvumelanisa kuzama futhi ngemva kokukhetha ngakunye. Akukho okuthunyelwa kusistimu yomthombo.
sync-conflict-refresh: Qalisa ukuvumelanisa futhi ukuze ubuyekeze amanani amanje.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Amakhadi owabelwe wona abuyekeziwe. Akusekho ukungqubuzana kwezinkambu. Ukuvumelanisa uhlu lonke akuzange kuqaliswe.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Susa kuphela ukuxhumanisa kokuvumelanisa kwale khophi ephindiwe. Okuqukethwe kuyo kuhlala ku-WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Ukufaka kungobo yomlando kuvinjwe amakhadi angaphansi asebenzayo
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Into yomthombo ayisekho, kodwa amakhadi angaphansi asebenzayo avimbela ukufakwa kungobo yomlando. Gcina leli khadi endaweni ngokususa ukuxhumanisa kwalo kokuvumelanisa. Amakhadi angaphansi awashintshwa.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Gcina ikhadi langaphambili lingashintshiwe bese udala ikhadi elisha lokuvumelanisa kulolu hlu. Ukuzama futhi kusebenzisa lelo khadi elingene esikhundleni.
sync-preview-saved: Kusekelwe ezilungiselelweni ezilondoloziwe. Ukuvumelanisa manje kulanda futhi kuhlole umthombo kabusha.
sync-preview-unavailable: Londoloza umthombo wokuvumelanisa ngaphambi kokucela ukubuka kuqala.
sync-preview-blocked: Xazulula ukungqubuzana okungezansi ngaphambi kokubuyekeza uhlelo lwezinguquko.
sync-preview-scope: Izibalo zibhekisela ezinkambini zomthombo ezihlelwe ngendlela efanayo. Idatha eyengeziwe ingase ingafakwa ngumhlaziyi womthombo.
sync-source-scope: Izindlela zihlanganisa ukuvela kwezinkambu ezintweni zomthombo. Izinto ezingaxhunyiwe zibikwa ziphelele; amanani azo awaboniswa.
sync-source-converted: Kuguqulelwe embhalweni noma kwenye indlela yokumelwa
sync-source-truncated: Umbiko ukhawulelwe ezindleleni ezingu-100 nasemagameni ezinkambu afinyeziwe.
sync-report-retention: Ukuqalisa kwakamuva okungu-20. Imibiko igcinwa izinsuku ezingu-30.
sync-report-partial: Ukuqalisa okuhlulekile noma okungakaqedwa kungenzeka kushintshe amanye amakhadi. Le mibiko ayiqhubeki nokuqalisa futhi ayihlehlisi okwenziwe.
sync-report-unavailable: Imibiko yokuqalisa idinga imvume yokubhala kulo lonke uhlu neseva etholakalayo.
sync-recovery-description: Imibiko yokuvumelanisa egcinwe ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ezidlule. Sesha nge-ID yebhodi noma yohlu. Umphumela ongakaqedwa ungase usaqhubeka noma uphazamisekile. Vuselela ukuze uhlole futhi; le mibiko ayikwazi ukuqhubeka noma ukuhlehlisa izinguquko.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazi ukufundwa ukuxilongwa kokuvumelanisa. Hlola imvume yomphathi nokutholakala kweseva.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Khetha inkambu yezinombolo ene-ID yenkambu ye-Jira neyunithi yesilinganiso, njengoba idalwe ukungenisa kwe-Jira okuxhunyiwe. Izinguquko zendawo zibuyekezwa njengokungqubuzana. Amanani omthombo angekho awanakwa; inani elithi null elishiwo ngokucacile lisula inani elixhunyiwe.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Isisindo noma isilinganiso sesikhathi se-GitLab sibhalwa enkambini yezinombolo oyikhethayo. Izinguquko zasendaweni zibuyekezwa njengezingxabano; udaba olungenasisindo lusula inani elixhunyiwe.
email-recovery-description: Umugqa owodwa ngomamukeli ngamunye. Sesha nge-ID yomsebenzisi. Okuqukethwe umlayezo nezinkambu ze-imeyili zomamukeli akuboniswa. Ukumisa isikhashana kubamba imilayezo ekhona nezayo; Ukuqhubeka kuzama futhi ukuthumela imilayezo esemugqeni manje. Ukukhansela kususa imilayezo efakwe emugqeni kuze kube yisikhathi sesicelo. Uma ukuthumela kumatasa, zama futhi maduze. Umlayezo osuqalile ukuthunyelwa awukwazi ukubuyiswa, futhi ukuthumela okungaqinisekisiwe kungase kuphindwe. Ukwehluleka okungapheli nemilayezo esifinyelele emkhawulweni wokuzama futhi kusala ukuze kubuyekezwe. Ukuzama futhi imilayezo ehlulekile kuqala umjikelezo omusha wemizamo futhi kugcina ukumiswa kwesikhashana okukhona.
email-recovery-empty: Ayikho imilayezo esemugqeni futhi abekho abamukeli abamiselwe ukuthumela isikhashana.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazi ukufundwa umugqa wama-imeyili. Hlola amalungelo omlawuli nokutholakala kweseva.
email-recovery-busy: Ukuthumela noma omunye umsebenzi womugqa uyaqhubeka. Vuselela bese uzama futhi maduze.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Vuselela umugqa bese uzama futhi umsebenzi ofanayo uma kudingeka.
email-recovery-superseded: Isenzo esisha somsebenzisi ophethe sithathe indawo yalesi sicelo. Kuboniswa isimo samanje somugqa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela yonke imilayezo esemugqeni manje yalo mamukeli? Okuqukethwe kuyo kuzosuswa futhi ngeke kubuyiselwe. Imilayezo emisha eyenziwe ngemva kwalesi sicelo izogcinwa.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Ukulethwa akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa; buyekeza ngaphambi kokuzama futhi
sync-time-estimate-hint: Izilinganiso zesikhathi zisebenzisa izinkambu zezinombolo zesikhathi sokuqala/esisele ezidalwe ukungenisa kwe-Jira. Kufanele kube nenkambu eyodwa kuphela efanayo kuleli bhodi. Ukuhlela kwendawo kubuyekezwa njengokungqubuzana; amanani omthombo angekho awanakwa futhi inani elithi null elishiwo ngokucacile lisula inani.
sync-planning-hint: I-sprint nokukhishwa kuvumelaniswa kuphela uma i-Scrum ivuliwe kuleli bhodi. I-sprint noma ukukhishwa okungekho kudalwa kuleli bhodi, ngezinsuku ezinikezwa umthombo; okukhona kufaniswa kuqala nge-ID yomthombo, bese kuba ngegama. Ushintsho lokuhlela lwendawo luhlala kuze kube yilapho umthombo ushintsha ukuhlelwa kwaleyo nkinga, futhi ukuvumelanisa kokuqala akukaze kususe ukuhlela.
activity-recovery-description: Izaziso ezingakaqedwa ziyazanywa futhi ngokuzenzakalelayo. Buyekeza imisebenzi engekho noma eshintshile ngaphambi kokuzama futhi. Ukuzama futhi akukaze kudale kabusha umsebenzi.
activity-recovery-busy: Esinye isisebenzi sicubungula lesi saziso. Vuselela bese uzama futhi.
activity-recovery-denied: Imvume yokufinyelela yomamukeli noma izintandokazi zezaziso azisakuvumeli ukulethwa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Umsebenzi wokuqala awukho noma ushintshile. Akukho okudalwe kabusha.
activity-recovery-failed: Akukwazanga ukuqedwa ukulethwa kwesaziso. Umsebenzi osalindile ugciniwe.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Lesi saziso sishintshile kusukela silayishwa. Buyekeza isimo esivuselelwe ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa isilungiselelo sokulethwa. Vuselela bese ubuyekeza isimo saso samanje.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Khansela unomphela ukulethwa okusele kwalo msebenzi? Lokhu ngeke kuqhutshwe futhi. Ama-imeyili asevele emgqeni nezaziso esezilethiwe azibuyiswa.
rule-email-recovery-description: Buyekeza imizamo erekhodiwe yokuthumela ama-imeyili emithetho. Imizamo engaqinisekisiwe kungenzeka isathumela noma iphazamisekile. Lo mbiko awuphindi uthumele futhi awukhanseli ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ayikho imizamo yokuthumela ama-imeyili emithetho efana nalokhu kusesha.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazanga ukulayishwa imizamo ye-imeyili yomthetho. Vuselela ukuze uzame futhi.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: I-WeKan ayilokothi iphinde ithumele i-imeyili engaqinisekisiwe ngokwayo. Ukuthumela futhi kuya kuphela kubamukeli abangaqinisekisiwe. Yimake njengethunyelwe uma wazi ukuthi ifikile, noma ukhansele ukuthumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ukuthumela kwasekuqaleni kungenzeka kusaqhubeka. Unganquma ngemva kuka-__time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Thumela le imeyili futhi kubamukeli abangaqinisekisiwe? Noma ubani iseva yakhe yemeyili eyamukele i-imeyili ngaphandle kokwazisa i-WeKan uzoyithola kabili.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Maka le imeyili njengethunyelwe kubo bonke? Yenza lokhu kuphela uma wazi ukuthi ifikile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela ukuthumela le imeyili? Ngeke ithunyelwe kubamukeli abangaqinisekisiwe.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ukuthumela kwasekuqaleni kungenzeka kusaqhubeka. Zama futhi kamuva.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ukuthumela futhi kwangaphambilini kungenzeka kusaqhubeka. Zama futhi kamuva.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Bonke abamukeli sebeqinisekisiwe. Kunalokho, yimake njengethunyelwe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Iseva yemeyili ayiphendulanga. I-imeyili ethunyelwe futhi kungenzeka ifikile noma ayifikanga; iboniswa njengokuqhubekayo.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Omunye umlawuli uxazulula le imeyili. Zama futhi maduze.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: I-imeyili egciniwe ayisahambisani nalo mzamo, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Irekhodi eligciniwe lalo mzamo alivumelekile, ngakho awukwazi ukuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Le imeyili ayikwazanga ukuxazululwa. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
rule-email-legacy-description: La ma-imeyili emithetho alungiswa inguqulo yangaphambilini ye-WeKan engazange ibhale ukuthi okuqukethwe kwawo kuvelaphi, ngakho i-WeKan ngeke iwathumele ngokwayo. Ngemva kokuhlola ukuthi umbhali womthetho usenalo ilungelo lokufinyelela, xhumanisa i-imeyili kabusha ukuze ilungiswe futhi kusetshenziswa isimo samanje sekhadi, noma uyilahle.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lungisa le imeyili futhi kusetshenziswa isimo samanje sekhadi? Okuqukethwe kwayo kungase kuhluke kulokho okwalungiswa ngaphambili.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lahla le imeyili? Ngeke iphinde ithunyelwe nhlobo.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Ayikwazanga ukulayisha ama-imeyili emithetho alinde ukubuyekezwa. Vuselela ikhasi ukuze uzame futhi.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Umbhali womthetho akasenalo ilungelo lokufinyelela kuleli khadi, noma umthetho ushintshile, ngakho i-imeyili ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa kabusha. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Umsebenzi obangele le imeyili ushintshile, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa kabusha. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ikhadi okuvela kulo le imeyili alisatholakali, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa kabusha. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ukusebenza komthetho okulungise le imeyili akusagciniwe, ngakho ayikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa kabusha. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Le imeyili isivele ithunyelwe, kuzanywe ukuyithumela, noma ilahliwe.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Lesi senzo asikwazanga ukuqedwa. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-description: Ngamunye wale misebenzi yokuvumelanisa uhlu egciniwe umile phakathi nendawo futhi awusakwazi ukuqedwa, ngoba uhlu lususiwe, ludalwe kabusha noma lumiswe kabusha, noma umsebenzisi owuqalile ulahlekelwe yimvume yokubhala. Uma owodwa usalindile, lolo hlu alukwazi ukuvumelaniswa. Wulahle ukuze uhlu lukwazi ukuvumelaniswa futhi: izinguquko esezisetshenzisiwe ziyahlala, izinguquko ezisele ezigciniwe azibhalwa nhlobo, futhi ukuvumelanisa okulandelayo kuqhathanisa uhlu nomthombo walo futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Uhlu lususiwe, ludalwe kabusha noma izilungiselelo zalo zokuvumelanisa zishintshile
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Umsebenzisi oqale lokhu akasenayo imvume yokubhala kulo lonke uhlu
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Kugcinwe inguqulo yangaphambili ye-WeKan ngaphandle kokuthi yini ekuqalile
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Kungaphindwa manje futhi kuzoziqedela, ngakho akukwazi ukulahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Lahla lo msebenzi wokuvumelanisa uhlu ogciniwe? Izinguquko esezisetshenzisiwe ziyahlala; ezisele azibhalwa nhlobo. Uhlu lungabe seluvumelaniswa futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Ayikho imisebenzi yokuvumelanisa uhlu elinde ukubuyekezwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Kuboniswa kuphela emidala kakhulu engu-50. Lahla eminye bese uvuselela ukuze ubone eminye.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Akukwazanga ukulayishwa imisebenzi yokuvumelanisa uhlu. Vuselela ukuze uzame futhi.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Lo msebenzi awutholakalanga ubambekile, ngakho awukwazi ukulahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Lo msebenzi ungaphindwa manje futhi uzoziqedela, ngakho awulahlwanga.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Lolu hlu luyavumelaniswa manje. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhashana.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Akukwazanga ukuqedwa lesi senzo. Vuselela bese uzama futhi.
interrupted-import-description: Ngakunye kwalokhu kungeniswa kwamabhodi kume phakathi nendawo - iseva iqale kabusha, noma ukungenisa kwehlulekile - kwashiya ibhodi elingaphelele. Ukungenisa akukwazi ukuqhutshwa, ngoba ifayela lomthombo aligcinwa. Gcina ibhodi njengoba linjalo, noma lilahle bese ungenisa ifayela futhi. Ukulahla kususa ibhodi elidalwe yilokhu kungenisa nakho konke okukulo, kufaka noma yini eyengezwe kulo kusukela lapho.
interrupted-import-scrum: Isigaba sakhona se-Scrum sinendawo yaso yokuqhubeka (__state__, isinyathelo __next__ kwezingu-__total__). Uma ugcina ibhodi, siqedele noma usilahle endaweni yokubuyisela ukungenisa kwe-Scrum yebhodi.
interrupted-import-counts: Imizila engu-__swimlanes__, izinhlu ezingu-__lists__, amakhadi angu-__cards__, izinhlu zokuhlola ezingu-__checklists__, amazwana angu-__comments__, okunamathiselwe okungu-__attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Gcina leli bhodi elingaphelele njengoba linjalo? Akukho okususwayo, futhi ukungenisa ngeke kusafakwa ohlwini lapha.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Lahla lokhu kungenisa? Ibhodi elidalwe yikho nakho konke okukulo kususwa unomphela.
interrupted-import-empty: Akukho ukungeniswa kwamabhodi okuphazamisekile okulinde ukubuyekezwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Kuboniswa kuphela okudala kakhulu okungu-50. Gcina noma ulahle okunye bese uvuselela ukuze ubone okwengeziwe.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Akukwazanga ukulayishwa ukungeniswa kwamabhodi okuphazamisekile. Vuselela ukuze uzame futhi.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Ibhodi elinalesi sikhombi alidalwanga yilokhu kungenisa, ngakho alithintwanga.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Isigaba sakhona se-Scrum sisabhalwa noma sisabuyiselwa. Zama futhi ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa.
interrupted-import-failed: Akukwazanga ukuqedwa lesi senzo. Vuselela bese uzama futhi.
saml-login-not-started: Lokhu kungena nge-SAML akuqalwanga kule thebhu yesiphequluli. Sicela ungene futhi.
history-request-pending-undo: Iseva ayikakuqinisekisi ukuhlehlisa kwakho ushintsho lokugcina.
history-request-pending-redo: Iseva ayikakuqinisekisi ukwenza kwakho ushintsho lokugcina futhi.
history-request-hint: Ukuzama futhi kuphinda isicelo esifanayo, ngakho akusoze kwahlehlisa ushintsho lwesibili.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ukuhlehlisa, ukwenza futhi noma ukubuyisela izinguquko ze-Scrum kumiswe ukungqubuzana. Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum kuleli bhodi kuvinjiwe kuze kube kuxazululiwe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Izinguquko ezingu-__applied__ kwezingu-__total__ zibhaliwe, ezingu-__pending__ azibhalwanga, kanti ezingu-__conflicted__ sezishintshwe ngomunye umuntu kusukela lapho.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ukubuyisela emuva kubuyisela wonke amarekhodi ashintshiwe esimweni sawo sangaphambili; kuvunyelwa kuphela uma kungekho omunye umuntu oshintshe lawo marekhodi kusukela lapho. Ukugcina ibhodi njengoba linjalo kususa umsebenzi omile futhi akushintshi amarekhodi. Kunoma iyiphi indlela, lokhu kuqoshwa kuPhaneli yomphathi, Izinkinga, Ukubuyisela.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Gcina wonke amarekhodi njengoba enjalo manje, kufaka izinguquko umsebenzi omile osuzibhalile?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umphathi webhodi angabuyisela emuva noma agcine ibhodi njengoba linjalo.
login-setting-after-restart: Kuqala ukusebenza ngemva kokuthi i-WeKan iqalwe kabusha
login-setting-env-only: Yimvelo yeseva kuphela esetha lokhu. Kuboniswa lapha ukuze kufundwe kuphela.
